product.title: Cliffs of Moher Day Tour from Dublin: Including The Wild Atlantic Way

description.text: Leave Dublin on a 12-hour coach day to the Cliffs of Moher via the Wild Atlantic Way. Numbered stops cover Kinvara Harbour, The Burren, Liscannor, the Cliffs of Moher Visitor Centre, and Bunratty Castle and Folk Park, with live commentary on board. Cliff admission is included so west-coast timing stays coordinated rather than split across separate tickets. Meet at 34 O'Connell Street Lower near The Spire. The long day is built for visitors who want cliff hiking and Burren limestone from a Dublin base. Stops include Kinvara Harbour, Wild Atlantic Way, The Burren, Liscannor, Cliffs of Moher, Bunratty Castle and Folk Park.
